question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

to give up completely or agree to forgo, especially in favour of another
solution: The correct answer is option 3), i.e., 'Surrender.' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • Let's look at the meaning of the marked option: • **Surrender**- to give up or yield something to someone else. (आत्मसमर्पण, हार मानना) • Example: • *The rebel soldiers were forced to **surrender.*** • ​Let's look at the meanings of the other given options:​ • **Waive**- to refrain from insisting on or demanding something. (अस्वीकृत करना, विवाद करना) • **Forfeit**- lose or be deprived of (property or a right or privilege) as a penalty for wrongdoing. (हानि, नुकसान; गलत काम के लिए दंड के रूप में (संपत्ति या अधिकार या विशेषाधिकार) खोना या वंचित होना) • **Cosign**- to sign a document with someone else, typically to share responsibility or liability. (सहस्थापन करना, सही हस्ताक्षर करना) • Hence, from the given meanings, we find that 'Surrender' is the correct one-word substitute. • So, the correct answer is option 3. 43:T658b,
